incident: OAuth setup-token failed repeatedly: fed code without #state suffix
lesson: the ENTIRE code#state string is the code; never 'clean' opaque tokens
enforcement: tools token-feeder fixed; noted in OPERATOR-RUNBOOK

incident: PRD/ADR commits stranded on test branch while 'PUSHED' reported against stale main
lesson: push claims need fresh-ref verification: git status -sb + log origin/main after push

incident: README claimed 'synced to July work state'; diff showed ~half of .claude missing, docs/ absent, tgz unopened
lesson: sync/import claims require file-count diff evidence, not intent
enforcement: docs/analysis/2026-07-24-work-archive-import.md with per-dir counts; rule: no sync claim without comm/diff output

incident: cp1255 console crashed unicode prints in scan.py
lesson: Windows console output must be ascii-safed; files keep full unicode
enforcement: safe() encoder in scan.py; pattern for all tools

incident: auto-compact continuation lost working state; fresh-compacted session at 64% context
lesson: conversations are not storage; disk is the only memory

incident: 3 parallel sessions converged: overlapping work, same phrasing
lesson: parallel sessions need structural separation (queues+charters), not intent

incident: phone RC spawns fresh orphan sessions; speech-to-computer unreliable
lesson: phone must reach a stateless-by-design intake, not a stateful stranger
enforcement: ADR-0013 concierge lane; RC pattern test pending (AUTO-05)

incident: review workflow exited non-zero on post-review cleanup though review posted
lesson: green must mean green; cosmetic failures train alarm-blindness
enforcement: review workflow green-means-green fix — tracked in TODO P2
